g.text: next up, today's medications and their doses (see Medications),
loads its view's days: List · 3 days · Week · Month
compact: calendar and agenda scroll beside Add
Timed entries last until their end, or 1 h
Planning and Overview share appointments, medications and the events the patient confirmed through ObservePlanning.
Events are optional: if they can't be read, appointments and medications still show. A caregiver gets medications and events only if the patient also shares Prescriptions and Events.
Appointment rows and the Overview's next appointment open AppointmentDetailScreen, event rows and its next event open EventDetailScreen; Back returns to the origin.
US-35: Planning → MedicationDetailScreen → PrescriptionDetailScreen; Back keeps the selected day.
US-50: the Overview's "Your circle" sheet (#457, planned) reads NotificationRepository; the caregiver's phone writes them right after the prescription (#458).
US-48 (planned): from 1 hour before to 2 hours after an appointment starts, the Overview shows a card from ObservePlanning that opens its symptoms summary (see Appointments).
The unshared Planning message scrolls with its available content. Overview messages use its existing scroll.
